**Blockers:** Jason explicitly paused all implementation/delivery. Native blocking dependencies: VerdifyConsultancy/verdify-platform#670. The listed acceptance boundary remains unproved beyond linked historical receipts.

**Next step on explicit resume:** After explicit Jason resume, refresh exact source/live and predecessor evidence, then satisfy: Live-role matrix allows intended functions and rejects unrelated DML, mapping reads and cross-workload capabilities.

**Acceptance retained:**
- [ ] Live-role matrix allows intended functions and rejects unrelated DML, mapping reads and cross-workload capabilities.
- [ ] No credentials or Secret annotation values enter issue/log/backup artifacts; ordinary pods lack owner/migration authority.
- [ ] Public/planner/ingestor health and experiment integrity survive rollout/rollback; no unsolicited credential rotation occurs.
